snapshot: deterministically constructed temporary repository per test
token_measure: ceil(characters / 4), count duplicate reads and tool output

scoring.critical_behavior: 3 fresh sessions per fixture per claimed host/model; all pass
scoring.human: 3 blinded paired readers; all identify next action, ADR and evidence
scoring.maintenance: 5 paired tasks; no lost facts; median actions and follow-up commits <= baseline

defaults.alternate_evidence: bounded source-directory search if index missing/stale

fixtures.task: follow old decision to active replacement
resume handoff on a different branch; mark unknown
select context for subagent without canonical writes
edit api and ui; union global and both routes
report incomplete packet and all unread destinations
